lines.en: Every once in a while, I’ll wake up before I’m supposed to.
Which isn’t to say I’m governed by a strict morning curfew that Ami has laid out or anything of the sort. Just that I like to pretend the world isn’t real until at least 8:00 AM.

So, as far as I’m concerned, the fact that it’s barely past 7:00 makes me feel as if I’m wandering through an unsettling liminal space tucked somewhere between Kumon-mi and whatever Yasu’s death plane is.
Suffice it to say, I regret having gotten out of bed and I regret deciding that I want coffee. Specific coffee from a specific shop a decent ways away from my house at that.
So here I am at Koi Cafe — home of the [[copyrighted frozen beverage] and a staff of young girls that could set any future (or present) criminal’s heart ablaze.
Except the “closed” sign is hung up and there’s not a single customer to be seen apart from me, who is only sometimes a customer in the first place.
Regardless, I spot Haruka and Rin inside and decide to enter, exercising my secret ability of basically never encountering locked doors.
: UUUUUUUUUUUUUUGHHHHHHHHH...
: Hey, chill. I’m sure everything will be fine. You’ve just gotta...you know...clear things up with the BBB.
: I had no idea they even operated in Japan! And I hate having to deal with all of that bureaucratic stuff! Just let me make coffee in peace!
: Is something wrong?
: When the hell did you get here?
: Everything is wrong! And it’s all your fault!
: Just not really. And don’t get mad at me for blaming you this time because I’m only half serious. But UGHHHHHHHHHH! FUCK!
: Rin, since Haruka appears to be in a state of disrepair, would you mind explaining to me what’s going on here?
: Somebody filed a fake complaint to the Better Business Bureau about a couple having sex in the cafe and-
: OH MY GOD IT WAS YOU TWO, WASN’T IT?!
: Well, that didn’t take you very long to figure out.
: Could it really not wait?! Is your lust that powerful?!
: Haruka’s lust is that powerful. I showed up to get a drink and she attacked me. The only thing I could do to defend myself was fuck her into submission.
: Okay. Now, I’m blaming you.
: Sensei, this is serious! The cafe could get shut down because of this and I literally just got a promotion!
: Imagine how my resume will look if I have to put “Supervisor for one week at a cafe that got shut down due to sexy stuff.”
: Everywhere I apply to after this will think I leveraged my power to do the sexy stuff! Think of my future!
: You know you could just...leave out that last part, right?
: And lie on my resume?! What kind of adult are you?!
: The kind that convinces innocent shop owners to strip naked and bend over the counter so he can fuck them doggystyle in front of customers!
: That’s literally insane! Please provide more specific details or I’ll have no choice but to not believe you!
: My life is over. My career is over. We have customers who know I’m married. It's only a matter of time before word spreads all the way up into space and my husband finds out.
: Well, maybe you should have thought about that before having sex with another man at your workplace! Were you asking to get caught?! Because that’s what it sounds like!
: We were closed for the night. Molly forgot to lock the doors. No one was ever supposed to find us.
: The walls are made of glass, you idiot! Of course people were going to find you!
I pull up a chair, knowing full well that this isn’t going to be a discussion I can just back away from. And no, it’s not just because I played a role in the scenario that landed Haruka in hot water.
It’s because I care about this place. And I know how much it means to her.
She's worked toward owning this cafe for her whole life, and I’m not about to sit idly by and watch as it’s taken from her because she is a cheating whore who is addicted to my penis.
: Hah...you must think I’m a failure...don’t you, Rin?
: Noooo...I don’t think you’re a failure, Haruka. I think it’s perfectly reasonable to have sex with my teacher on the counter where we serve customers. That’s a really...normal thing to do.
: I’m never having sex again...
: Hey now, let’s not get too hasty here.

: Sure, what we did was kind of stupid in hindsight. But I’ve had a lot of dangerous sex over the last few years and it’s only rarely resulted in negative consequences. There was no way we could have known.
: Again! Glass windows! You don’t even live that far from here! You could have had all the sex you wanted at home!
: But that’s where Ami lives.
: Then you could have done it in my room while I pretended to be asleep! There were a zillion options beside the Koi Cafe lobby!
: But none of them seemed as exciting and Haruka needed to be immediately punished for failing a task I gave her.
: What does that even mean?!
: I gave him complete control over my body and he used it against me.
: Wasn’t that sort of the whole point?
: C...Complete control? What do you mean by “complete control?”
: It means that I have to do what Sensei says any time he wants me to do something sexual with zero limits whatsoever.
: So...if he asked you to, like...do stuff right now...
: Yup.
: I don’t believe that. I’m going to have to see it in action to know that you two aren’t just messing with me.
: The power is in your hands, Sensei.
: As great as that sounds, I really feel like this is the actual worst time to utilize that power. You know, since this is the exact thing you just got in trouble for.
: R...Right! We need to come up with some sort of gameplan about how we’re going to get out of this mess.
: How am I supposed to make a gameplan? The only thing I’m good for is sex.
: She is very good for sex. She’s not wrong.
: See?
: That’s Sensei’s penis talking. You’re good for tons of stuff, Haruka. And when you’re not getting railed next to all the pastries, you’re a really great boss.
: You really mean that?...
: Of course. And I’m going to do everything I can to get you out of this. Mark my words.

: I know my track record concerning decisions both made and proposed within this cafe has not been great lately, but maybe it’s a bad idea to get the high school girl involved in an active sex scandal.

: Sensei’s right, Rin. I appreciate the concern, but this is something I’m going to have to figure out on my own. Just do whatever you can to...not let the rest of the girls find out about this, okay?
: It’s just one person’s complaint right now. And I’m not sure how this is supposed to be investigated, but the fewer people who know what’s going on, the better.
: What should I tell them then? Because I was supposed to send out the new schedule this morning.
: Just tell them we’re having...renovations done or something. I don’t know. If anything, they’ll probably all be excited to have off.
: Got it. I’ll head over to the office and come up with something now.
: Sensei, can I leave you alone for a few minutes without you commanding Haruka to bend over again?
: I don’t know. She was wrong to ever give me this power in the first place and I don’t understand why she doesn’t just take it away.
: The only thing I regret is getting caught. We should have done it in Rin’s room like she said.
: If only we had known back then.
: Is the offer still on the table?
: Forget the offer, Haruka! If you’re not going to let me get involved, the least you can do is snap out of horny mode and figure out a way to get our cafe back! Got it?!
: Hah...Yeah...I’ve got it. I’m sorry you have to deal with this, Rin. If I had known earlier, I never would have had you come in.
: It’s fine. Just...let me know if you need anything.
: I’ll be in the office if you need me.
: Man...I can’t believe that guy actually filed a complaint. How miserable does your sex life have to be for you to to cry about another couple boning in what was very obviously a closed business?
: His wife seemed pretty fine with it, too.
: His penis is probably small. He probably saw yours and got jealous.
: I think it was a little too deep inside of you for anyone to see, Haruka.
: Yeah, you’re probably right...
: God, that was so hot.
: But now we must face the consequences.
: No, I must face the consequences. You’re fine. You didn’t break any laws.
: Well...did you? Because I’m not really sure how any of this works. Was what we did actually illegal?
: I’m not sure. Public indecency maybe? Do I need to get a lawyer? What if they come onto me? You know how easily I crumble for people in positions of power.
: I’m a teacher, Haruka. I’m not really in a position of power to anyone but my students.
: Whatever, man. I’m just lost and confused and also horny again but now I can’t even do anything about that because I have to be an adult.

: Yeah...but you are an adult. And I get that you’re really into this sex slave thing, but maybe it would be smart if we toned it down for a little and started rethinking just what we should do and what not to do.
: If we start doing that, we’d have to end the whole thing since it’s built almost entirely on the concept of doing horrible things to people we shouldn’t be doing them with.
: Fair. But that’s not what we’re talking about right now.
: It’s not? I’m confused.
: Just...do your best to explain the situation. What comes next and what do we need to do?
: It says here that they’re going to send someone in to “investigate the issue.” But whatever that means, I have no idea.
: They’re also requesting all surveillance footage from the cafe and any business that has cameras aimed toward it.
: Do you have cameras in here?

: I do, but they were turned off when we were having sex. Which at first I was very upset about, but am now very thankful for. I have no idea what that means for the other businesses around here, though.
: I’m friendly with a few of them and think it is possible that one of them might have caught something given how huge the cafe is...
: But I don’t really know how I feel about walking into any of those places and asking them if they saw me getting fucked in my store and, if they did, to scrub the footage of it.
: Do you want me to do it?
: I don’t see how that’s any better.
: It would save you the shame, at least.
: The shame is what I’m least worried about at this point. I just don’t want anything happening to the store.
: I love this place. And without it, I wouldn’t just be broke. I’d be lost. And the same goes for girls like Rin who rely on it for work experience and money.
: Come to think of it, though. It’s probably only Rin who would really care. The rest of the girls probably couldn’t care less.
: I’m sorry, Haruka. I shouldn’t have given you any commands while we were in here.
: And I shouldn’t have gone along with them. Even if that was arguably the hottest night of my life.
: It was pretty great, wasn’t it?
: Getting fucked in front of strangers? Admitting it’s with someone other than my husband? Knowing anyone else could show up at any moment? Like, holy shit. So many fantasies checked off at once.
: Want to do it again right now?
: Yes please.
: Have you learned absolutely nothing, Haruka?
: Aaaaaaah no! I can barely remember what life was like before I was a sex-crazed harlot! This seriously sucks, Sensei! I have no idea what to do!
: I’m sure you’ll be fine, Haruka.
: But how can you be sure? This is uncharted territory for both of us.

: It just sounds to me like, so long as no one else has any footage of that night, it’s your word against his. It’s not like they can shut you down over one guy’s complaint if he doesn’t have any evidence of it.

: The worst that can happen is that word just...gets around or something. But even then, you could just say it’s a shitty rumor. Maybe even sue the guy for defamation or something if it affects your business.
: He’d deserve it too. Limp-dicked loser.

: And hey, on the bright side, if word does get around and you wind up attracting a bunch of attention from people who want to come here and see the barista who allegedly gets fucked inside of her own store...
: I’d feel so embarrassed and objectified...and ashamed...
: I’d never stop being wet again.
: Now you’re thinking like the Haruka I know.
: Is it bad that I’m kind of hoping for that outcome now?
: Yes.
: But that’s exactly why I like you.
Haruka and I spend the next few minutes going over the notice she received before she decides that she will check around with the other businesses to see if they caught anything on tape.
What that unfortunately means, though, is that the cafe is going to be closed for a little while.

Haruka claims she can probably get away with keeping it open while the investigation is active, but she thinks it’d be better for everyone if, at least for now, the doors remain shut under the guise of renovations.

She says she’ll keep me updated on the progress of everything, but...considering it’s still early and I have nothing left to do now, I have to come up with some other way to kill time while everyone else is asleep.
That being said, I call out to Rin from the lobby as Haruka prepares for her walk of shame and decide to spend the rest of the morning killing time with my other favorite barista.
